record.question: Which of the following best distinguishes a stateful firewall from a stateless firewall?
options: A stateful firewall filters packets only based on IP address and port number
A stateless firewall maintains a table of active connections and tracks session state
A stateful firewall tracks the state of active connections and makes decisions based on context
A stateless firewall provides better protection against application-layer attacks
